summary: Plan 06 P10 assigns IFX-only contracts to Shared, Diff or CI ownership and removes seven byte-identical IFX copies in favor of canonical V3 contracts through a fail-closed expand/contract bridge.
rationale: The package-root contracts directory obscures authority. Cross-stage IFX schemas belong to shared/contracts; authorization and protected-change schemas belong to Diff; deployment and required-check schemas belong to CI. decision, plan, pre-result, profile, project-map, rule and tech-stack are byte-identical to the portable V3 contracts and therefore use V3 as their single authority instead of moving duplicate copies. The migration first teaches base-owned readers to accept exactly one IFX legacy or owned path, while permitting a portable legacy copy only when byte-identical to V3, then consumes exact move/delete, trusted-base and policy authorizations. This applies D7, D15, D23 and D24 to the contracts mapping in Plan 06 section 13.
